voices.student_north: Bhai 1.25 million youth jobless by 2031. Tab tak humara placement bhi ho jayega ya nahi — pata nahi. But agar hua toh salary itni hogi ki lost generation se bhi gareeb lagenge. Report likha hai, humara CV likha hai — dono barbaad.

voices.professional_north: Bhai 1.25 million young log unemployed hone waale hain 2031 tak. Aur hum sochte hain apna job secure hai. Ek din boss ko bhi realize hoga ki fresh graduate se kaam karavate hain aधा salary mein — tab tak hum bhi "lost generation" ho jayenge, par EMI to chalti rahegi.

stories.headline: An unhealthy focus on sex - Married at First Sight UK insiders on show's 'toxic' culture
stories.summary: Fresh revelations come after two women told the BBC they had been raped on the Channel 4 reality show.

voices.student_north: Bhai yeh "Married at First Sight" dekha? Toxic culture, rape cases — aur hum yahan assignment submit karne ke liye stress mein hain. Inhe at least TV par attention mil raha hai, hamare professor ko assignment dikha toh bas F deta hai. Unka drama national, haara apna toh sirf internal marks mein hota hai.
voices.student_south: Bhai, reality TV par rape cases aa rahe hain. Meanwhile humara reality TV toh college placement drive hai — jahan HR bhi toxic culture spread kar rahe hain, par atleast woh "married at first sight" nahi kar rahe. Small mercies only.
voices.professional_north: Yaar, itna toxic culture toh hamara office mein bhi hai — bas difference yeh hai ki wahan cameras hain aur yahan boss ka stare. Reality TV show mein rape cases ho rahe hain, aur hamara reality mein appraisal denial — dono mein consent nahi puchhi jaati.
voices.professional_south: Bhai, reality TV pe 'reality' nahi hai — sirf toxicity hai. Humara office mein bhi same culture, bas cameras nahi hain. Boss harassment ko 'mentoring' bolte hain, toxic meetings ko 'team building.' Atleast TV waalon ko channel switch kar sakte ho, hum toh apna job switch karte hain aur phir same environment milta hai.

stories.headline: Paul McCartney on playing guitar with Paul Mescal: 'He knew it better than I did!'
stories.summary: The music legend on delivering "memory songs" for his 20th solo album, The Boys of Dungeon Lane - and why he's intrigued by the new Beatles biopics.

voices.student_north: Bhai Paul McCartney ne guitar Paul Mescal se seekha. Humko assignment ke liye senior se code copy karna padta hai, yeh log toh legend se inspiration lete hain. Hum placement ka wait kar rahe, yeh toh new album launch kar rahe — different league ka stress hai.
voices.student_south: Paul McCartney bhaiya guitar sikhane gaya Mescal se. Legend ko naya album banate waqt beginner ka feel aa raha. Tum bhi same vibe — assignment submit karte waqt professor ko doubt poochte ho aur wo bolte ho "tum mujhe sikhao." Atleast Paul ko album mil gaya, tumhe fail milega.
voices.professional_north: Yaar Paul McCartney ne admit kar diya ki kisi aur ne guitar usse better samjha. Mera boss bhi har meeting mein yeh karta hai — mere kaam ko dekh ke kehta hai "tu samajh nahi raha, main explain karta hoon." Guitar seekhna hai toh album banao, nahi toh apna presentation mein hi bhul jaao.
voices.professional_south: Bhai, Paul McCartney 80 saal ka hai aur still learning guitar from juniors. Aur mera boss? 45 saal, same company 15 saal, aur abhi bhi "best practices" seekhne ke liye mujhe training sessions attend kara raha hai. Ego aur age ka koi direct relation nahi hota, boss ka samajhna padta hai.

stories.headline: BBC News wins Emmy Award for coverage of Myanmar earthquake
stories.summary: Its reports and live updates on the devastating tremor were marked at an event in New York on Wednesday.

voices.student_north: BBC ko Emmy mila Myanmar earthquake coverage ke liye. Acha baat hai, unhe award milta hai breaking news pe. Humko toh placement ka award bhi nahi milega — bas stress aur sleepless nights milenge. Atleast BBC walon ke paas job security hai, humara toh tremor ke baad hi collapse ho jayega.
voices.student_south: BBC won Emmy for covering Myanmar earthquake. Meanwhile our campus WiFi went down yesterday and nobody even noticed. Haan, at least BBC gets awards for breaking news — our placement cell breaks promises every semester. Coverage excellence vs. placement excellence — one actually exists.
voices.professional_north: BBC ko Emmy mile earthquake coverage ke liye. Yeh toh sahi hai — jab hum apni performance report lete hain to boss kehta hai "aur bhi improve karo," par BBC ne ek natural disaster cover kiya aur award le gaya. Hamara deadline miss hua, hume improvement notice mil gaya. Emmy aur notice dono awards hain bas receiver different hai.
voices.professional_south: BBC ne Emmy jeet li earthquake coverage ke liye. Mast coverage, live updates — sab kuch perfect tha. Hamara boss ko bhi itni perfection chahiye quarterly reports mein, par usko deadline se pehle deliver karne wala koi nahi milta. Emmy toh dusre ko mil gaya, hamein toh bas OT milta hai.

stories.headline: Matthew Perry's assistant jailed for 41 months over actor's ketamine death
stories.summary: Kenneth Iwamasa, who pleaded guilty last year to one count of conspiracy to distribute ketamine causing death, said he "will forever regret" his actions.

voices.student_north: Yaar, Matthew Perry ka assistant 41 months jail jayega. Aur dekho — humara assignment submission assistant abhi tak submit nahi kiya. Agar hum drugs dena shuru karein toh kam se kam jail mein free food milega. College mein toh biryani bhi paid hai.
voices.student_south: Bhai Matthew Perry ka assistant ne ketamine deal kiya aur 41 months inside. Meanwhile humara chemistry professor ne hume assignment ka answer WhatsApp pe bheja aur hum guilty feel kar rahe hain. Moral of story: even celebrities' helpers get caught, but our profs? Unaccountable since 2019.
voices.professional_north: Yaar, assistant ki job itni dangerous hai? Ek toh boss ki suni padti hai din bhar, upar se legal trouble bhi. Humara assistant toh sirf coffee galat order karta hai, par isse toh jail bhi ho sakta hai. Moral of story: kisi ka bhi assistant mat bano, apne liye kaam karo — atleast apne aap pe toh trust kar sakte ho.
voices.professional_south: Bhai, Matthew Perry ka assistant jail gayi. Apna boss ka assistant hoon — mujhe bhi jail jana padega kya? Kyunki daily jo stress deta hai, main uska "medication" le kar kaam karunga toh apna hi bail padega. Atleast Perry ka assistant ne famous death diya, mera sirf slow death hoga spreadsheets se.
